source.question: For the October 2–5, 2026 tests, can you confirm that each release actually delivered 4,000 g of salt into the stream, including any salt left in the bucket?
source.answer: 4,000 g was delivered in each release
source.scope: Nine Nisqually releases on October 2, 4 and 5, 2026; no other releases.
source.limits: Mass measurement uncertainty is not quantified. This does not approve windows, calibration applicability or scientific acceptance.
